name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Lent Calendar
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood.
    - Multi-layer wooden construction for durability and dimensional design.
    - Product consists of 4 wooden layers:
                       +) Layer 1 (Main Panel): Wooden 5mm – 2-sided printing.
                       +) Layer 2 (Channel Bottom Wall): Wooden 5mm – 1-sided printing.
                       +) Layer 3 (Channel Side Walls & Slider): Wooden 3mm – 2-sided printing.
                       +) Layer 4 (Lid Frame & Lid): Wooden 3mm – 2-sided printing.
    - Precision laser-cut edges for detailed craftsmanship.
    - Solid and durable structure designed for long-term use.
    - Comes with pre-attached suspension hanging string
    - Alternative version includes punched holes with a white hanging rope (5mm thickness)

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
                       +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
                       +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Advanced UV printing technology.
    - High-resolution printing with sharp and vibrant colors.
    - Fade-resistant and long-lasting finish.
    - Printing applied depending on layer structure:
                       +) Main panel: 2-sided printing.
                       +) Channel bottom wall: 1-sided printing.
                       +) Channel side walls & slider: 2-sided printing.
                       +) Lid frame & lid: 2-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative wooden wall décor for homes, offices, or special spaces.
    - Can be used as a countdown board, milestone tracker, or themed decorative display depending on the design.
    - Sliding markers allow users to track days, events, progress, or special moments.
    - Perfect for personal décor, seasonal displays, or meaningful reminders.
    - Easy to hang on walls, doors, or decorative areas with the included hanging string.
    - The layered wooden structure adds a unique 3D visual effect to any interior space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for family members, friends, or loved ones.
    - Suitable for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, housewarming, and special celebrations.
    - Perfect for people who enjoy meaningful décor and personalized keepsakes.
    - Ideal for adding a sentimental touch to homes, offices, or personal spaces.
    - A unique decorative piece that combines creativity, craftsmanship, and personal expression🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Lent Calendar

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
